circumstances_desc: As announced by MLT on 12 August 2026, MLT has issued 17,976,013 new units payable to MLTM and 1,105,112  new units payable to Mapletree Property Management Pte. Ltd. ("MPM"). Both MLTM and MPM have nominated Mulberry Pte. Ltd. to receive the aggregate of 19,081,125 new units payable to them. Following the receipt of new units by Mulberry has resulted in the change in percentage level of its interest held by Mulberry.
title: Change in Mulberry Pte. Ltd's position in Mapletree Logistics Trust
body: Mulberry Pte. Ltd executed a transaction for 19,081,125 shares of Mapletree Logistics Trust. This increases their holdings from 916,670,369 to 935,751,494 shares.
reasons: Calculated price (transaction_value/amount_transaction=0.54) does not match reported price_per_share=1.176
Inconsistent total value: expected 22439403.00 (amount_transaction * price_per_share), but got 10277823.00

circumstances_desc: On 12 August 2026, MLT has issued (1) 10,277,823 new units payable to MLTM at S$1.176 per unit as payment of performance fee; and (2) 7,698,190 new units payable to MLTM and 1,105,112 new units payable to Mapletree Property Management Pte. Ltd. ("MPM") at S$1.2221 per unit as payment of base fee, property and lease management fees. Both MLTM and MPM have nominated Mulberry Pte. Ltd. to receive the new units and total number of units in issue following this issuance is 5,138,977,874.
title: Change in Mapletree Logistics Trust Management Ltd's position in Mapletree Logistics Trust
